question:
The bar graph given below shows the marks obtained by the given 5 students in English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ed1f3540fcbde10b15beb003e6a57411a4eb06175337abed98af6d0140be6c6.png] 

Marks obtained by T are what percent more than the marks obtained by S?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Student
 Marks Obtained in English
 
 

 P
 70
 
 

 Q
 65
 
 

 R
 80
 
 

 S
 60
 
 

 T
 75
 
 

**Formula Used:**

Percentage More = [(Higher Value − Lower Value) ÷ Lower Value] × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ Marks obtained by student T = 75

⇒ Marks obtained by student S = 60

⇒ Difference in marks = 75 − 60 = 15

⇒ Percentage more = (15 ÷ 60) × 100

⇒ Percentage more = (1 ÷ 4) × 100

⇒ Percentage more = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**
